sentences.text: The NSW Independent Commission Against Corruption outlines corruption risks in regulatory work and ways to prevent them.
sentences.support: its focus is on highlighting common corruption risks associated with regulatory work and suggesting some potential ways to prevent corrupt conduct.

sentences.text: It examines risks created when staff move between regulators and the industries they oversee.
sentences.support: This term refers to the movement of employees between the regulator (or related government role) and the regulated industry.

sentences.text: The Commission identifies discretion over enforcement, including decisions to take no action, as a source of corruption risk.
sentences.support: It is the discretion to take regulatory action in different parts of the pyramid

sentences.text: The Commission advises agencies to assess capture risks, screen recruits, train staff and manage relationships with former or prospective employers.
sentences.support: Evaluate regulatory capture during risk assessments and business planning exercises.
sentences.section: Addressing regulatory capture and the revolving door

findings.quote: The safest and best option is always to refuse it and report the matter immediately.

notes: No separate summary or numbered recommendations list. The quoted recommendation refers to an offered bribe; allegations in case studies are not treated as findings.
